text:
Use the e-prescription app now to record your decision to donate organs in the **digital organ donation register** – safely and easily.

There are currently 9,192 people in Germany waiting urgently for an organ – every decision counts and can save lives.

Make your decision today and make an important contribution to the future of many people! ❤️‍🩹

You can find the organ donation register in the “Settings” tab in this app.

**ePA compatibility** 
 🤝 Your prescriptions are now fully compatible with the electronic patient file. 
 
 **Improved** 
 ✨ Expired prescriptions are now archived.

**Better readability** 
 We have made our brand color a little darker to increase the color contrast and thereby improve readability. 
 
 **Optimized input field** 
 The cursor in the input field for the access number has been removed.

🛒 **Improved order flow** 
The ordering process is now easier and faster. 
 
🌐 **New languages** 
Our app is now also available in Spanish and Irish. 
 
📞 **Expanded contact options** 
We have introduced new contact options for selected insurance companies. 
 
🔍 **Detailed access logs** 
We now also display the telematics IDs in the access logs, making it easier to identify who had access.

**📲 Redeem prescribed DiGAs** 
You can now redeem prescriptions for digital health applications (DiGAs) directly via the e-prescription app. The prescriptions will be issued by specialists in Hamburg as part of a pilot project. You can find your activation code and the link to the DiGA right here in the e-prescription app. 
 
 **🏥 New pharmacy database** 
We have introduced a new, future-proof database for pharmacy searches.

**♿️ Accessibility** 
Our accessibility statement is now available in the settings. The onboarding process has also been made more accessible. 
 
 **📲 Redeem DiGAs with insurance companies** 
 Prescriptions for digital health applications (DiGAs) can now also be redeemed with other insurance companies.

**🙌 Registration for privately insured people** 
Registration for privately insured people has been optimized. You can log in conveniently with your health ID in just a few clicks. 
 
 **🏥 Updated pharmacy data** 
Changes that pharmacies make in the new database are now reliably displayed. 
 
 **📲 More information for DiGAs** 
From now on you will receive more detailed information about your DiGA prescriptions, such as the sales price or the logo. 
 
 **♿️ Accessibility** 
The screen for entering the health card access number has been redesigned and is now optimized for use with VoiceOver. 
 
 **📤 Share prescriptions** 
Prescriptions can now be shared with others directly from the app.

**♿ Accessibility** 
The profile settings have been revised to further increase accessibility.

**🏛️ Registration for More People** 
Registration is now also possible for insured persons of federal institutions, such as the Federal Police and others. 
 
 **🕒 Improved Pharmacy Opening Hours** 
Emergency service and special closing times for pharmacies are now displayed, if available. 
 
 **💊 Selection of All Prescriptions** 
When redeeming prescriptions, all prescriptions can now be selected simultaneously. 
 
 **♿ Accessibility** 
The colors of fonts and icons have been adjusted to achieve higher contrast. Additionally, VoiceOver speech output for editing the profile picture and recognizing the login status has been improved.

**✨ Show prescription codes** 
The screen for batch and single codes has been redesigned for more intuitive use. 
 
 **❤️ Pharmacy Favorites** 
Pharmacy favorites now work more reliably and are compatible with VoiceOver. 
 
 **♿ Accessibility** 
VoiceOver and keyboard navigation are improved, buttons, text, and input fields are more easily identifiable, and list items are more logically structured. Enlarged font now works on all app screens. Animated videos play only once to support users with cognitive impairments.

**🏥 Enhanced Pharmacy Details** 
Pharmacies can now add services such as vaccinations and on-site features like barrier-free access. Pharmacies can be filtered based on this new information. 
 
 **✨ Improved Pharmacy Search** 
Recently used pharmacies and favorite pharmacies are now more clearly separated. The filters have been improved. 
 
 **✅ Health ID for Individuals with Alternative Insurance** 
Individuals who are not covered by statutory or private health insurance can now also log in using their Health ID. 
 
 **♿ Accessibility** 
The filters now have higher contrast, and their status is more easily identifiable. The accessibility statement has been updated and expanded to include a section documenting the change history. Some buttons have been adjusted for improved visibility.

**✅ T-Prescriptions available**
T-Prescriptions can now be received and displayed correctly. T-Prescriptions are used for certain medicines with special safety requirements.

**⚙️ Settings cleaned up**
The profile settings have been revised and made clearer.

**🔐 Login improved**
Registration with the insurance app is now faster.

**🛡 Tracking removed**
We have removed the tracking tool from the app. No app usage data is being collected anymore.

**♿ More accessibility**
Texts with explanatory notes can now be read in full even with enlarged font sizes.
